claim: The demo shows the bundled CLI's four-file preflight report: 0 ready, 3 review, and 1 reject.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:sample-scan
sandbox: Fresh browser context opens /demo; asserts four rendered rows, exact counts, and the generated CLI transcript.

claim: Demo mode uses sample data, saves nothing, and never reads real license or layout storage.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:demo-sandbox
sandbox: Fresh context with seeded real storage opens ?demo=1; asserts banner, reset, start-real link, no real-storage reads, and same-origin requests.

claim: The scanner leaves original files unchanged.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:read-only-scan
sandbox: Runs the bundled CLI demo and compares SHA-256 hashes of all shipped input files before and after.

claim: Reports redact GPS coordinates by default.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:gps-redaction
sandbox: Runs the bundled CLI demo and asserts GPS presence, the false inclusion flag, and no latitude or longitude fields.

claim: Generic, PhotoPrism, and Lightroom profiles classify formats as accepted, version-sensitive, or rejected.
where: homepage checks and README report contract
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:format-decisions
sandbox: Creates XMP, AVIF, and INSV inputs; runs all three real CLI profiles and asserts each support decision and rejection finding.

claim: The scanner detects embedded JPEG previews in RAW headers using a 24 MiB inspection limit.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:embedded-preview
sandbox: Creates RAW inputs with a JPEG inside, absent, and beyond the 24 MiB inspection boundary; asserts available and missing results.

claim: The scanner reports GPano XMP, near-2:1 dimensions, and cautious filename projection hints.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:projection-hints
sandbox: Creates a GPano sidecar, a valid 8000x4000 TIFF, and a PANO filename; asserts each distinct kind and evidence string.

claim: The scanner translates EXIF orientation values 1 through 8 and flags values outside that range.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:orientation-validation
sandbox: Generates nine valid TIFF fixtures; asserts every 1-8 label and the orientation_invalid finding for value 9.

claim: The scanner compares complete SHA-256 file digests to report duplicate bytes regardless of filename.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:duplicate-detection
sandbox: Creates two differently named equal files and one unequal file; asserts one duplicate, its digest and source path, and no false positive.

claim: The scanner distinguishes complete, missing, partial, and garbled camera make/model metadata.
where: homepage camera identity check and README
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:camera-metadata
sandbox: Generates TIFFs with complete, absent, partial, and control-byte camera identity; asserts statuses and structured findings.

claim: The --include-gps option emits parsed coordinates only after explicit opt-in.
where: homepage location check, privacy policy, and README
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:gps-inclusion
sandbox: Generates a TIFF at 37°48′30″ N, 122°24′15″ W; proves default redaction and exact coordinates after --include-gps.

claim: JSON reports use schema 1.0; exit codes mean ready 0, findings 1, and scan error 2; only exact report destinations are excluded.
where: homepage installation section and README report contract
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:report-contract
sandbox: Runs ready, findings, and missing-folder cases; asserts schema fields and proves the named output is excluded while another JSON file remains scanned.

claim: Each scanned original receives a SHA-256 digest in the JSON report.
where: homepage checks and README report contract
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:sha256-report
sandbox: Runs the bundled demo, checks four 64-character report digests, and recalculates each shipped input digest.

claim: The CLI has no telemetry, account, or network client dependency.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:local-cli-privacy
sandbox: Checks the shipped Rust manifest and scanner sources for network or telemetry clients, then runs the bundled local demo.

claim: The CLI exports JSON and CSV, does not follow symlinks, and uses exit code 2 for scan errors.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:json-csv-exit-codes
sandbox: Creates a temporary card with a sidecar and external symlink; checks both exports, omitted symlink, and a missing-folder error.

claim: The website sample does not upload visitor files.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:local-demo-privacy
sandbox: Fresh context runs the homepage sample while recording requests; asserts same-origin only and no file input.

claim: The demo works offline after the first visit.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:offline-reload
sandbox: Dedicated browser context opens ?demo=1, waits for the service worker, goes offline, reloads, and checks all four rows.

claim: A returned or restored license is verified immediately, and a cached verdict applies only to that token.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:license-verification
sandbox: Mocks verification for a replacement token and a restored token; verifies both calls and unlocked state.

claim: An unchanged verified license is checked with Sociobot at most once per day.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:license-daily-check
sandbox: Seeds a current valid token-bound verdict, intercepts verification, and asserts no request is made on load.

claim: The migration set creates a printable and downloadable location-redacted PhotoPrism or Lightroom brief from a local report.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:migration-brief
sandbox: Mocks a valid license, loads the CLI-derived sample, generates both destination briefs, downloads Lightroom text, and invokes print.

claim: Existing migration licenses can save, reload, apply, and delete destination and order layouts in browser storage.
where: migration set, privacy policy, terms, and README
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:paid-layouts
sandbox: Mocks a valid license; saves a Lightroom format-order layout, reloads, applies it over changed controls, deletes it, and checks local storage.

claim: A revoked license stops unlocking paid layouts after its next daily verification.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:license-revocation
sandbox: Seeds an expired cached valid verdict, returns a recorded revoked response, and asserts the paid workspace locks and stores the invalid verdict.

claim: The site does not offer new purchases while checkout registration is incomplete; existing license restore remains available.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:checkout-status
sandbox: Opens the site and terms; asserts the unavailable status, no broken checkout link, and an operable existing-license restore control.

claim: A pasted migration report stays in the page and is not uploaded.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:pasted-report-privacy
sandbox: After a mocked license unlock, loads the local sample report and records only same-origin fixture traffic.

claim: The scanner is MIT licensed and its source is available on GitHub.
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:open-source
sandbox: Reads the shipped MIT license and checks the homepage source link.
